# Getting help

- **Questions, ideas, and things you built:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/CycleChain/CycleWire/discussions).
- **Bugs:** [open an issue](https://github.com/CycleChain/CycleWire/issues/new/choose) with the affected
  version and a minimal reproduction.
- **Security problems:** do not open an issue; follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- **Documentation:** [docs/](../docs/README.md), and the runnable [examples](../examples/README.md).
